output_text:
Claude Code guidance: enterprise, cross-platform dotfiles for macOS/Linux/WSL; tiered shell, tmux, Neovim.

Commands:
```sh
./install.sh install standard
./install.sh install minimal
./install.sh install full
./install.sh install ai_focused
./install.sh --dry-run install standard
./install.sh link
dot setup
dot check
dot update
dot reload
dot project init
dot ai review
dot security scan
dot metrics dashboard
dot plugin list
dot migrate status
./tests/test_runner.sh
dot test quick
./tests/test_runner.sh --category infrastructure
find . -name "*.sh" -exec shellcheck {} \;
find . -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | xargs yamllint
dot check
dot doctor
dot test run
perf-status
perf-bench
perf-quick
./install.sh --
```

Architecture: `bin/` CLI/utilities; `config/` templates/core; `lib/`; `plugins/`; `scripts/`; `tests/`. Main CLI `bin/dot`; modular libraries: `lib/cli/core.sh`, `lib/cli/ai.sh`, `lib/cli/security.sh`, `lib/cli/project.sh`, `lib/cli/testing.sh`. Tools in `config/tools.yaml`; profiles: minimal, standard, full, ai_focused; auto OS/distro/package-manager detection.

Plugins: `plugins/core/`, `plugins/community/`, `plugins/local/`; template `plugins/local/hello-world/`. Neovim: `config/nvim/init.lua`, `config/nvim/lua/core/`, `config/nvim/lua/tiers/`, `config/nvim/lua/languages/`; tiers: 8 essential, 23 enhanced, 33+ advanced
